newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela says up to date on Paris Club debt now.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela says up to date on Paris Club debt now.

text.p: Venezuela is up to date on payments due to the Paris Club for debt accrued between 1992 and 1995, acting Planning Minister Armando Leon said.
"Venezuela has brought itself up to date on its Paris Club debt payments and has absolutely no outstanding arrears," Leon told reporters after the economic cabinet's weekly meeting.
Leon said the most recent payment had been for $70 million, but gave no further details.
According to Finance Ministry statistics, debt arrears totalled $793 million as of June 30 this year.
